COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
SA No.17 of 2026
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, Advocate for the 
appellant.
2. The present second appeal is preferred by 
the appellant being aggrieved against the 
impugned judgment and decree dated 08.11.2023 
passed by the Civil Judge (S.D.), Nainital in Civil 
Case No.105 of 2021 titled as “Devendra Prasad 
Budhlakoti vs. Manish Shah & Another”, and the 
judgment and decree dated 03.12.2025 passed by 
the District Judge, Nainital in Civil Appeal No.21 of 
2023 titled as “Devendra Prasad Budhlakoti vs. 
Manish Shah & Another”, whereby the learned trial 
court dismissed the suit of the appellant/plaintiff, 
which was affirmed by the learned Appellate Court.
3. After going through the impugned 
judgments and reliefs sought in the plaint, the 
present second appeal is admitted on the following 
substantial questions of law:-
“(i) Whether the suit of the plaintiff for 
declaring the sale deed dated 01.07.2021 void 
and ineffective in the form of mandatory 
injunction was itself maintainable?
(ii) Whether the judgment passed by 
appellate court is in contravention of mandatory 
provisions of Order 41 Rule 31 of Civil Procedure 
Code, 1908?”
4. Issue notice to the respondents. Steps to be 
taken within two weeks.
5. Summon the Trial Court Record.
6. List this case on 17.04.2026.
[ 
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.)
 27.02.2026
Ravi
